log.title: QUASI-JUDICIAL. 4103 Old Trace Road [25PLN-00296]: Request for a Streamlined Housing Development Review to Construct 16 Dwelling Units on Eight Total Lots, Including Eight Single-Family Residences and Eight Junior Accessory Dwelling Units. One Single Family Home and JADU would be Provided at Below Market Rate. A Separate Vesting Tentative Map Application (25PLN-00298) Has Been Filed for the Proposed Subdivision. The Project Requests Concessions and Waivers Pursuant to State Density Bonus Law. A Compliant Senate Bill 330 Pre-Application Was Filed on October 1, 2025. log.verdict: checker rejected: The headline omits a material fact: the official item specifies this is a 'QUASI-JUDICIAL' proceeding before the Architectural Review Board, not a standard review. A non-partisan civic site must include the quasi-judicial character, as it materially affects how residents understand the nature of the proceeding (it involves findings and standards, not discretionary judgment). The headline's omission creates a factual gap that could mislead readers about the proceeding type.

log.title: Approval of Second Amendment to the Lease Between the City of Palo Alto and Community Skating, Inc. for the Tennis Facility at 3005 Middlefield Road, Extending the Term to January 1, 2040; CEQA Status – Categorically Exempt
log.draft: The City Council considers extending the lease for the tennis facility at 3005 Middlefield Road.
log.verdict: checker rejected: The headline omits material facts from the official item: (1) it is a SECOND amendment to an existing lease (not just 'considers' a lease); (2) the term extends TO a specific date (January 1, 2040), which is a concrete fact, not mere consideration; (3) the lessee is named as 'Community Skating, Inc.' — a specific entity. While the headline is not false, it is incomplete enough to be misleading about the nature of the action (this is approval of an extension, not consideration of whether to lease). The phrase 'considers extending' softens what is presented in the agenda as an approval item.
